# Tokyo 5-Day Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A balanced Tokyo itinerary for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14** with a **$2,800 total budget excluding international flights**. It keeps each day to 2–3 main stops, uses train-friendly areas, and leaves room for meals, rest, and flexible wandering.

## Trip Plan by Day

### Day 1 — Arrival, Asakusa, and Easy First Night
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and settle near a major station.
- Afternoon: Light walk around **Asakusa** and **Senso-ji**; browse Nakamise shopping street.
- Food: Tempura set or casual ramen near Asakusa Station.
- Transit tip: Use the **Ginza Line** or **Asakusa Line** for simple airport-to-city and neighborhood transfers.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$180**
  - Hotel: $140
  - Food: $30
  - Local transit: $10

### Day 2 — Museums and Ueno Park
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: **Tokyo National Museum** or **National Museum of Nature and Science**.
- Afternoon: Relax in **Ueno Park** and choose one smaller museum or gallery if energy is good.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/31/2014_02_08_ueno.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Relax in **Ueno Park** and choose one smaller museum or gallery if energy is good, Tokyo, Japan
- Food: Lunch at Ueno’s market area; dinner in nearby Okachimachi.
- Transit tip: Stay on the **JR Yamanote Line** for easy station-to-station movement.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$210**
  - Hotel: $140
  - Tickets: $30
  - Food: $30
  - Transit: $10

### Day 3 — Tsukiji, Ginza, and Evening Waterfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: **Tsukiji Outer Market** for breakfast and snack-hopping.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/07/Sashimi_at_the_Tsukiji_Markets_-_Tokyo_Japan_%28Unsplash%29.jpg Alt=Morning: **Tsukiji Outer Market** for breakfast and snack-hopping, Tokyo, Japan
- Afternoon: Walk through **Ginza** for shopping, architecture, and a café break.
- Evening: Optional low-key visit to **Toyosu** or a short waterfront stroll.
- Food: Sushi breakfast, tamagoyaki, grilled seafood, and dessert in Ginza.
- Transit tip: Go early to Tsukiji; the market is best before crowds peak.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$230**
  - Hotel: $140
  - Food: $55
  - Transit: $10
  - Snacks/extra: $25

### Day 4 — Day Trip to Hakone
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Morning: Take the train to **Hakone** early for a full but relaxed day.
- Afternoon: Ride the ropeway, enjoy lake views, and choose one major scenic stop instead of trying to do everything.
- Evening: Return to Tokyo and keep dinner simple near the hotel.
- Food: Bento on the way out, then a casual izakaya or curry back in Tokyo.
- Transit tip: Use the **Odakyu Romancecar** or a JR-compatible route depending on where you stay.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$320**
  - Hotel: $140
  - Day-trip transit: $90
  - Admissions/ropeway: $40
  - Food: $50

### Day 5 — Meiji Jingu, Harajuku, and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Visit **Meiji Jingu** for a calm final cultural stop.
- Afternoon: Short walk through **Harajuku** or **Omotesando** for lunch and last-minute shopping.
- Food: Café brunch or a simple donburi bowl before heading out.
- Transit tip: Keep luggage stored at the hotel or station lockers to avoid dragging bags around.
- Estimated cost for 2: **$190**
  - Hotel: $140
  - Food: $35
  - Transit: $10
  - Misc.: $5

## Budget Fit and Hotel Choice

| Item | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Mid-range hotel, 4 nights | $560 |
| Food and drinks | $200–$260 |
| Local transit | $40–$60 |
| Museum and attraction entry | $60–$120 |
| Hakone day trip | $120–$180 |
| Buffer for snacks, lockers, extras | $120–$200 |
| **Trip total** | **$1,100–$1,380** |

### Recommended hotel style
- **Best area:** **Ueno, Asakusa, Tokyo Station, or Shinjuku**
- **Best fit:** a mid-range business hotel within a **5–8 minute walk** of a major station
- **Why:** easier airport access, simple day-trip departures, and lower taxi dependence
- **Good room target:** **$120–$180 per night** for 2 adults

## Transit and Pacing Tips

- Use a **Suica or Pasmo** card for trains and station convenience.
- Keep most days to **2 major sights plus one food stop**.
- Schedule the day trip in the middle of the trip so the first and last days stay light.
- Avoid stacking too many neighborhoods in one day; Tokyo transit is easy, but walking fatigue adds up fast.
- Build in a **mid-afternoon café break** most days to keep the pace comfortable.
